verdict.rationale: Zulip's topic-based channels let messages be organized so side discussions stay attached to the original context; users can move messages between topics and start new threads from existing ones, and community reviewers explicitly praise this as superior to flat chat threading (zulip-docs-16, zulip-docs-21, zulip-comm-2, zulip-comm-9). Minor caveats exist (occasional confusion or mis-posting to wrong topic per zulip-comm-5/6) but these are usability friction, not evidence the capability fails. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation of a dedicated 'reply-in-thread' UI distinct from topic assignment, and no admin-specific guidance on managing side-discussion threads.
